%----------------------------------------------------------------------------
\chapter{Measurements}\label{chap:measurements}
%----------------------------------------------------------------------------

A revocation check takes \SI{2}{\milli\second} with the \registry and \SI{40}{\milli\second}
with the full list, as \autoref{tab:times} shows.

\begin{table}[!ht]
  \centering
  \begin{tabular}{lr}
    \toprule
    Method & Time \\
    \midrule
    Full list & \SI{40}{\milli\second} \\
    \registry & \SI{2}{\milli\second} \\
    \bottomrule
  \end{tabular}
  \caption{Median time of one revocation check.}
  \label{tab:times}
\end{table}
